classification: Controlled semantic fallbacks. These are internal patterns informed by GIGW/DBIM principles, not official DBIM components.
policy: Use a fallback only when no approved DBIM component matches the requested need. Use local HTML/CSS/JS only, declare the fallback ID in output and mark it for manual review. Never represent a fallback as an official DBIM component.

patterns.purpose: Data-entry form with labels, required indicators, error summary and inline errors.
Responsive data table with caption, header cells and an accessible empty state.
Search/filter results list when a documented DBIM sample does not fit.
Success, warning, error or informational feedback.
No-results or no-data state with clear next action.
required_semantics: button or link when action is available

patterns.purpose: Document upload field with format/size/help/error information.
Summary metrics/status layout where no DBIM sample directly fits.
